addr.description: Advertiser address, most significant octet first (02:00:00:00:00:01).

disconnect.description: End the connection instead of opening one.

interval.description: Connection_Interval in 1.25 ms units (Core Vol 4 Part E 7.8.12).

mtu.description: Client receive MTU to exchange once connected; 0 exchanges none.

random.description: The address is random (TxAdd). Taken from the scan report when one is known.

service.description: Connect to the first connectable advertiser listing this service UUID; `pk` is the Passport Keys vendor service.

timeout_ms.description: Virtual time this call may spend before E_TIMEOUT.

wall_budget_ms.description: Host time this call may spend before E_WALL_BUDGET.

within_ms.description: How long to wait for a connectable advertisement.
